thestatsapi.evidence: fixture records carry no referee field; /stats has no referee node

footystats.evidence: refereeID is None for 2982/2982 upcoming (incomplete) matches in the forward cache; populates only post-match

footystats_refereeID.note: refereeID is an integer id populated AFTER the match completes

history_classification.footystats: per-match refereeID (id only) available post-match; career card/foul RATES are NOT provided by the API and must be derived by aggregating the corpus (as scripts/raw_stats_discovery.py does with expanding rates)
history_classification.thestatsapi: no referee data in fixture or /stats payloads observed

per_league_coverage_note: Because referee assignment is post-match only, pre-match per-league coverage is 0% in both sources across EPL/Championship/Ligue2/LaLiga2.
implication_for_engine: The asymmetric engine's cards conditioning cannot use the actual assigned referee pre-match. The league-level expanding card-rate is the PRIMARY pre-match path, not a fallback. A referee-specific rate is only usable in backtest (post-match id) or if a separate pre-match referee-assignment feed is added.
